layout: Full screen, 1:1 (the camera zooms up to ~1.2×). Layout must match: sky and backdrop above y≈200, a wooden picket fence along y≈200–245, open snowy ground below. Players walk in x 90–1830, y 280–1028. A frozen pond sits exactly at the centre: ellipse centre (960, 652), radii 205×88, with a ~20 px snowy rim. Keep the top ~110 px calm (scoreboard chips) and the ground plain — the code draws the walls, snowmen, splats and scoop dents
description: A cozy winter cottage garden seen from a high 3/4 top-down angle: pale blue sky with soft clouds, snowy hills, two candy-coloured cottages with thick snow on the roofs and warm yellow windows, snow-tipped pine trees, a honey-wood picket fence with snow caps and a string of colourful party lights; below it a wide smooth field of fresh snow with gentle blue-shaded drifts and tiny sparkles, a small oval frozen pond (pale cyan ice with white streaks) in the middle, snowbanks and pines along the left, right and bottom edges

layout: Game-select shelf and how-to screen (`drawIcon` is the fallback)
description: Two cheerful roster characters mid snowball fight in a snowy garden: one ducking behind a snow-fort wall, a snowball flying in a dotted arc toward a snowman with a red scarf, a white splat burst, a giant snowball and a red knitted mitten in the corners, falling snowflakes. Subject centred

layout: Centred on the ball, drawn at 2.3 × its radius (7–12 px radius: in hands, in flight, and as the 3 ammo pips over each head). The ball should fill ~87% of the canvas
description: A single round packed snowball: white with soft blue shading at the lower right, a small white highlight at the upper left, a few tiny lumps, thin navy outline

layout: Centred on the ball, drawn at 2.15 × its radius (26–66 px). The code does not rotate it, so keep it nearly round
description: A huge round snowball, lumpy packed snow with blue cel shading and a big white highlight, navy outline

layout: Centred inside the floating pickup bubble, ~97 px wide; the code draws the glow and the bubble around it
description: Power-up icon: a giant sparkly snowball with a little gold star twinkle on it, cheerful and chunky

layout: Centred, drawn 30–100 px tall: on the pickup bubble (the code adds "x3" beside it), in the player's hand, and next to the ammo pips
description: A red knitted mitten with a yellow and a white stripe and a fluffy white cuff, upright, thumb on the left

layout: Ground decal centred where a snowball landed; the code squashes it vertically to 42% and fades it out. Drawn 36–150 px wide, so paint it as a round splat seen from straight above
description: A white snow splat seen from above: a star-shaped burst of packed snow with little round blobs flung around it, faint blue shading, thin soft-blue outline

layout: Centred on a character's eyes for ~2 s after a hit, drawn at 2.4 × (15% of the character's height), fades out
description: A cartoony blob of white snow stuck on a face: a round splat with three bumps and two little drips, navy outline, light blue shading

layout: Stretched over a horizontal fort-wall block: footprint 230×44 plus an 84 px front face, so the top 34% of the image is the top face and the bottom 66% the front face. Damage lowers it to ~60% height (stretched) and the code adds cracks
description: A packed-snow fort wall made of stacked snow bricks, seen from a high 3/4 angle: flat white top face with a slightly lumpy edge, blue-shaded front face with brick seams, navy outline

layout: Same, for the two walls that run away from the viewer at the sides: footprint 44 wide × 170 deep plus the 84 px front face, so the top 67% is the top face and the bottom 33% the front face
description: The same snow-brick fort wall seen end-on: a long narrow white top face and a short blue-shaded front end with brick seams

layout: Bottom-centre anchored at the wall's front edge, fitted into (wall length + 30)×60 px; shown while a crumbled wall waits to rebuild
description: A low pile of broken snow bricks and lumps, white with blue shading, navy outline

layout: Bottom-centre (base of the bottom ball) on the snowman's foot point, fitted into 150×210 px. Hit 1 swaps to `-nohat`, hit 2 to `-body`, hit 3 to `-pile`
description: A friendly three-ball snowman: coal eyes and smile, carrot nose, pink cheeks, twig arms, a red knitted scarf, a blue bobble hat

layout: Same canvas, scale and placement as `prop/snowman`
description: The same snowman without its hat

layout: Same canvas, scale and placement as `prop/snowman`
description: The same snowman with only the two lower balls, the scarf and twig arms (its head has been knocked off)

layout: Bottom-centre on the snowman's foot point, fitted into 130×70 px, until it rebuilds
description: A flattened snowman: a lumpy snow heap with the red scarf and the carrot on top
